cat > /root/entrainment_gated_ft/run_all_340m_eval.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base
cd /root/entrainment_gated_ft
export HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1

MODELS=(
  "340M-20B-RetNet-pure"
  "340M-20B-RetNet-hybrid-3-1"
  "340M-20B-RetNet-hybrid-6-1"
  "340M-20B-RetNet-hybrid-12-1"
  "340M-20B-RetNet-hybrid-24-1"
  "340M-20B-HGRN2-pure-baseline"
  "340M-20B-HGRN2-hybrid-3-1"
  "340M-20B-HGRN2-hybrid-6-1"
  "340M-20B-HGRN2-hybrid-12-1"
  "340M-20B-HGRN2-hybrid-24-1"
)

TASKS="lambada_openai,hellaswag,winogrande,arc_easy,arc_challenge,mmlu"
LOG_DIR="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/lm_eval_clean/340m"

echo "=== START: $(date) ==="

for MODEL in "${MODELS[@]}"; do
  echo ">>> EVAL START: ${MODEL} at $(date)"
  OUTPUT_DIR="${LOG_DIR}/${MODEL}"
  mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}"
  
  python run_lmeval_clean.py \
    --model_path "/root/autodl-tmp/models/${MODEL}" \
    --tasks "${TASKS}" \
    --output_dir "${OUTPUT_DIR}" \
    --batch_size 16 \
    2>&1 | tee "${OUTPUT_DIR}/eval.log"
  
  EXIT_CODE=$?
  if [ $EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
    echo ">>> EVAL FAILED: ${MODEL} (exit code ${EXIT_CODE})"
  else
    echo ">>> EVAL DONE: ${MODEL} at $(date)"
  fi
done

echo "=== ALL DONE: $(date) ==="
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/entrainment_gated_ft/run_all_340m_eval.sh
